data.title: 鸢一折纸 · AST 休假海滩的测风
data.description: 【海滨训练基地·晴日】折纸穿着蓝白运动泳装坐在浮标旁，认真记录风速，却被飞来的海鸥叼走了纸角；她追到浅水边，白发被海风吹乱，最后面无表情地举起找回的记录本。
data.action: 浮标旁记录风速被海鸥抢纸，追入浅水后举起找回的记录本
data.lighting: hard blue daylight softened by sea haze
data.promptProse: Having followed a gull into the shallows to retrieve her stolen page, Origami Tobiichi holds the recovered waterproof notebook up in quiet triumph beside the orange buoy. Wind-tossed hair accompanies her navy-and-white athletic swimsuit, waist-tied windbreaker and waterproof sandals. The horizontal medium view includes the buoy and shallow ripples behind. Blue daylight softened by sea haze lights the notebook and buoy, with water reflections moving across their lower surfaces.
